LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_NeedGame: Load a game to choose its content mode. Existing and new saves default to Full.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_TreeHelp: Uses the tree’s actual sources and required prerequisites. Cross-tree fusion cards are excluded. Trees sourced only from trials or ruins have no ordinary offers.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_Help: Affects future draft batches; acquired upgrades remain. The current batch, its rerolls and random bonus cards keep their original mode. Switching never redraws offers for free.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_ScopeHelp: Filters ordinary offers and random bonus cards without removing content. Existing star progression and fixed trial/ruin rewards keep their rules. Costs and rarity settings remain the same.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_PoolCounts: Definitions in this mode: colony {0} / personal {1} / equipment {2} (prerequisites, stack limits and enabled status still apply).
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_UnavailableTree: This tree has no ordinary offers. Choose another tree or mode. The pool does not fall back to Full; tickets are retained.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_EmptyPool: No claimable offers in this mode. Your ticket is retained. Check prerequisites, stack limits, rarity and disabled entries, or change the mode for the next batch.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_EmptyRefresh: No other legal offers remain in this batch’s original mode. No reroll was spent.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_ShortBatch: This batch has only {0} legal offers; all are shown.
LanguageData.RHA_Modes036_Requirements: Next batch: prerequisites / generating recipient / stack limit / rarity restricted
